def transform2(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg: continue
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
          if (r,c,dr,dc) in seen: continue
          # walk back to the first point in this same-color diagonal run
          sr,sc=r,c
          while 0<=sr-dr<h and 0<=sc-dc<w and grid[sr-dr][sc-dc]==color:
            sr-=dr; sc-=dc
          run=[]; rr,cc=sr,sc
          while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==color:
            run.append((rr,cc)); seen.add((rr,cc,dr,dc)); rr+=dr;cc+=dc
          if len(run)<2: continue
          def outside_count(pos):
            pr,pc=pos
            runset=set(run)
            return sum(1 for ar in range(max(0,pr-1),min(h,pr+2)) for ac in range(max(0,pc-1),min(w,pc+2)) if grid[ar][ac]!=bg and (ar,ac) not in runset)
          a,b=run[0],run[-1]
          na,nb=outside_count(a),outside_count(b)
          if na==nb: continue
          end=a if na<nb else b
          neighbor=run[1] if end==a else run[-2]
          sr=end[0]-neighbor[0]; sc=end[1]-neighbor[1]
          rr,cc=end[0]+sr,end[1]+sc
          while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==bg:
            out[rr][cc]=color; rr+=sr;cc+=sc
    return out

source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    processed = set()

    for row in range(height):
        for col in range(width):
            color = grid[row][col]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                if (row, col, dr, dc) in processed:
                    continue

                start_row, start_col = row, col
                while (
                    0 <= start_row - dr < height
                    and 0 <= start_col - dc < width
                    and grid[start_row - dr][start_col - dc] == color
                ):
                    start_row -= dr
                    start_col -= dc

                run = []
                r, c = start_row, start_col
                while 0 <= r < height and 0 <= c < width and grid[r][c] == color:
                    run.append((r, c))
                    processed.add((r, c, dr, dc))
                    r += dr
                    c += dc

                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue

                run_cells = set(run)

                def outside_neighbors(point):
                    pr, pc = point
                    return sum(
                        1
                        for nr in range(max(0, pr - 1), min(height, pr + 2))
                        for nc in range(max(0, pc - 1), min(width, pc + 2))
                        if grid[nr][nc] != background and (nr, nc) not in run_cells
                    )

                first, last = run[0], run[-1]
                first_count, last_count = outside_neighbors(first), outside_neighbors(last)
                if first_count == last_count:
                    continue

                endpoint = first if first_count < last_count else last
                inner = run[1] if endpoint == first else run[-2]
                step_row = endpoint[0] - inner[0]
                step_col = endpoint[1] - inner[1]
                r, c = endpoint[0] + step_row, endpoint[1] + step_col
                while 0 <= r < height and 0 <= c < width and grid[r][c] == background:
                    output[r][c] = color
                    r += step_row
                    c += step_col

    return output
'''
